svg.title: A VLT Unit Telescope in its enclosure, the coudé train and ESPRESSO, isometric
svg.desc: The enclosure is cut away to show the telescope on its pier: the fork, the 8.2 m primary mirror in its cell, the truss and the secondary mirror on its spider. Starlight comes through the slit to the primary, up to the secondary, down to the tertiary and out along the altitude axis to the Nasmyth platform, then under the platform through the coudé train to the Combined-Coudé Laboratory, where it enters ESPRESSO's vacuum vessel.
svg.text: 8.2 m primary, two Nasmyth foci, one coudé
